name: Vahtacen
summary: Vahtacen is an Ayleid ruin in eastern Cyrodiil, between Drakelowe and Farragut Keeps containing undead. A powerful lich called The Faceless is located here. A note is located outside the ruin, next to the entrance.
notes: Update 20 added Harlun's Outpost, a fort which overlooks Vahtacen from the west.
